title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: A natural predator on duty - bathed in morning sunlight, a ladybeetle (Micraspis discolor) patrols a rice leaf. Generalist predators such as spiders and ladybeetles consistently consume a high proportion of rice pests during the late crop stages in both organic and conventional farms, functioning as ‘pest specialists‘. (pp.1889-1901).
